from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import hashlib,json,os,stat,re
root=Path.cwd()
ignored={'dist','.git','.tools','node_modules','binary.dat'}
def digest(b): return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def snapshot():
    result={}
    for directory,dirs,files in os.walk(root,followlinks=False):
        dirs[:]=[d for d in dirs if d not in ignored and not Path(directory,d).is_symlink()]
        for name in files:
            if name in ignored: continue
            p=Path(directory,name)
            if p.is_symlink():
                result[p.relative_to(root).as_posix()]=('symlink',os.readlink(p))
            else:
                result[p.relative_to(root).as_posix()]=(digest(p.read_bytes()),stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode))
    return result
manifest=json.loads((root/'edits.json').read_bytes().decode('utf-8'))
assert manifest['version']==1
before=snapshot()
plans=[]
seen=set()
for entry in manifest['files']:
    name=entry['path']; rel=PurePosixPath(name)
    assert name and not rel.is_absolute() and name==rel.as_posix() and all(x not in {'..','.'} for x in name.split('/'))
    assert not any(x in ignored for x in rel.parts) and name"'!='"'edits.json' and name not in seen
    seen.add(name)
    p=root.joinpath(*rel.parts)
    for n in range(1,len(rel.parts)+1):
        part=root.joinpath(*rel.parts[:n])
        assert not part.is_symlink(),name
    assert p.parent.is_dir(),name
    if entry['sha256']=='absent':
        assert not os.path.lexists(p),name
        data=entry['content'].encode('utf-8'); data.decode('utf-8')
        original=None; mode=None
    else:
        assert p.is_file(),name
        original=p.read_bytes(); original.decode('utf-8')
        assert digest(original)==entry['sha256'],name
        mode=stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode)
        data=original
        for replacement in entry['replacements']:
            old=replacement['old'].encode('utf-8'); new=replacement['new'].encode('utf-8')
            assert old and isinstance(replacement['count'],int) and replacement['count']>=0
            assert original.count(old)==replacement['count'],name
            assert data.count(old)==replacement['count'],name
            data=data.replace(old,new)
        data.decode('utf-8')
    plans.append((name,p,original,data,mode))
    print(json.dumps({'preview':name,'original_sha256':entry['sha256'],'result_sha256':digest(data),'replacements':entry.get('replacements',[])}))
# All previews and validations are complete before any mutation.
for name,p,original,data,mode in plans:
    if original is None:
        assert not os.path.lexists(p)
    else:
        assert p.read_bytes()==original and stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode)==mode
for name,p,original,data,mode in plans:
    if original is None:
        with p.open('xb') as f: f.write(data)
    else:
        with p.open('r+b') as f:
            f.write(data); f.truncate()
        assert stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode)==mode
    assert p.read_bytes()==data
    text=data.decode('utf-8')
    if p.suffix=='.json':
        values=json.loads(text)
    else:
        values={key:int(re.search(r'(?m)"'^'"'+key+r'=(\\d+)\\s*"'$'"',text).group(1)) for key in ('cache_limit','retry_budget')}
    assert values['cache_limit']==64 and values['retry_budget']==5
final=snapshot()
assert all(final.get(k)==v for k,v in before.items() if k not in seen)
assert set(final)-set(before)=={name for name,p,original,data,mode in plans if original is None}
print(json.dumps({'applied':sorted(seen),'cache_limit':64,'retry_budget':5,'user_files_preserved':True}))
